'''L3-V5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was stationed aboard the [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']] where it contacted a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] regarding the threat posed by [[Directive 7]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
L3-V5 serves as the courier for Republic players for Flashpoint: Directive 7 in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
